column1: # obd_ii_tps_and_airflow_plausibility_monitor() (runs once per 100 ms via obd_ii_monitor_task_scheduler_token bit 0x10).
# Per-DTC health counters are seeded with their CAL debounce count in obd_ii_update_tps_and_throttle_dtcs() and
# zeroed when the DTC fails; the tail folds them into engine_state_failure_flags bit2 (TPS) and bit16 (throttle/airflow).
